evidence.boundary: Real api.stripe.com test API; genuine Stripe CLI signed HTTP delivery; production Ring routes; isolated PostgreSQL

old-checkout-control.json.observation: Legacy Checkout request shape remains accepted by current Stripe API. Extra open test session expired without payment.

parent-legacy-replay-proof.json.boundary: Manual HMAC-signed local HTTP replay of unmodified canonical real Stripe API 2020-03-02 events, not a second genuine Stripe delivery

browser-proof.checkout: Hosted test card Checkout completed and returned to loopback success page.
browser-proof.flexible-account-and-portal: Account page showed updated USD7 monthly Price; actual Manage billing details button opened hosted active USD7 portal.
browser-proof.classic-account-and-portal: Account page rendered the archived custom legacy USD5 monthly Price; actual button opened hosted active USD5 portal.
browser-proof.canceled-account: After the signed deletion, the real account page showed no current plan and listed available offers.
browser-proof.fresh-registration: Final clean bootstrap developer registration page displayed the fresh USD5 monthly Price.

verification.clean-bootstrap-startup-and-owned-proces: passed by actual start, SIGTERM, all captured descendants gone, both ports closed, and fresh restart
verification.manual-signed-canonical-2020-payload-rep: passed created original Price, updated replacement Price, and deleted null membership; exact original canonical payload bytes signed locally, not another genuine Stripe delivery

limitations: No production deployment, webhook endpoint version change, account-default upgrade, or live-mode writes.
The classic subscription is a new fixture. Historical subscription state was not migrated or exhaustively replayed.
The backfill trial creation was checked; collection at its trial end was not checked.
Payment-failure policy, event ordering, deduplication, and multiple subscriptions per customer remain unchanged.
The old Checkout request shape was accepted by the real target API. This run does not show that compatibility was removed.
payload-version-note: Stripe stores the canonical events at the unchanged account default API version 2020-03-02. Stripe CLI --latest delivered the actual signed HTTP payloads rendered as 2026-11-18.endive.

bootstrap-proof.credentials-source: Only the unique sk_test_ token was selected from ignored .envrc text. The shell file was never evaluated.
bootstrap-proof.cleanup-correction: Give the owned app and listener separate sessions. Terminate their saved process groups so Lein and its JVM both stop.
bootstrap-proof.final-state: Fresh app, listener, and isolated PostgreSQL left running for the user. Final Checkout is open and uncompleted.
